Taped 1/7/03; Tucson, AZ
1/9/03:
The Big Show (w/ Paul Heyman) pinned Rikishi at 4:08 with the chokeslam
John Cena (w/ Bull Buchanon) pinned WWE Smackdown! Tag Team Champion Chavo Guerrero Jr. (w/ WWE Smackdown! Tag Team Champion Eddie Guerrero) at 4:56 with a roll up and holding onto the ropes for leverage
WWE Cruiserweight Champion Billy Kidman pinned Matt Hardy (w/ Shannon Moore) at 4:26 in a non-title match with a roll up after Moore’s interference backfired
Tajiri pinned Jamie Noble (w/ Nunzio) at 5:00 with the kick to the head
Charlie Haas (w/ Shelton Benjamin & WWE World Champion Kurt Angle) pinned Edge at 6:44 with a suplex after Angle hit Edge with his crutch; after the bout, Chris Benoit made the save
Chris Benoit defeated Shelton Benjamin via disqualification at 6:45 after Kurt Angle hit Benoit with his crutch; after the match, Edge attempted to make the save but was also beaten down
Bill DeMott pinned Shannon Moore (w/ Matt Hardy) at 2:57 with a gutwrench powerbomb; after the match, Hardy – who had been doing guest commentary for the bout – hit the Twist of Fate on Moore
WWE Smackdown! Tag Team Champion Eddie Guerrero (w/ WWE Smackdown! Tag Team Champion Chavo Guerrero Jr.) pinned Bull Buchanon (w/ John Cena) at 4:10 with the frog splash
Brock Lesnar pinned Albert at 3:01 with the F5

WWE (Smackdown!) @ Trenton, NJ – Soveriegn Bank Arena – January 11, 2003
Rikishi pinned John Cena (w/ Bull Buchanon) in a Kiss My Ass match after superkicking a chair into Cena’s face
Sho Funaki pinned Red Dogg with a cradle
Jamie Noble & Nunzio defeated Nova & Spanky when Noble forced a submission from Nova
Matt Hardy (w/ Shannon Moore) pinned Chuck Palumbo with the Twist of Fate after Moore interfered
Brock Lesnar pinned the Big Show in a No DQ match following a chair shot
Bill DeMott pinned Shannon Moore with a sit-down powerbomb
